about_the_game:
You are already dead.

In Bodyless, you become the ghost of a political prisoner wandering through the shadows of Taiwan’s martial law era. Float through confined cells, distorted courtyards, and fragmented memories where folklore and state control intertwine.

As you navigate shifting architecture and collapsing spaces, subtle mechanical systems infiltrate the environment. Sound surrounds you. Reality bends. Memory fragments. Bodyless is an immersive VR experience where history is not explained, but felt.

《Bodyess》｜Key Features

  • First-Person Ghost Perspective: Become the spirit of a political prisoner, drifting through spaces in VR.

  • Immersive Historical Atmosphere: Experience the era of martial law through space, sound, and perception.

  • Surreal Narrative World: A reality where folk beliefs, surveillance systems, and fragmented memories intertwine.

《Bodyess》｜Selected International Awards

  • Golden Mask Award, NewImages Festival (2019)

  • Jury Special Mention, Kaohsiung Film Festival (2019)

  • Honorary Mention, Prix Ars Electronica (2020)

  • Best Virtual Reality, Los Angeles Film Awards (2020)

  • Official Selection, Venice International Film Festival – VR Competition (2019)

  • Official Selection, International Documentary Film Festival Amsterdam (2019)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Win 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070 / RTX 2060 / RX 580 with 6 GB ram
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 256 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR
  • Additional Notes: *Only support SteamVR compatiable devices
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Win 10
  • Processor: Intel Core Core i7 / AMD Ryzen 7
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1080 / RTX 2070 or 2080 / RX 5700 with 8 GB ram
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 512 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: *Only support SteamVR compatiable devices

short_description: Bodyless is a VR journey set during Taiwan’s martial law era. You inhabit the ghost of a political prisoner, moving through fragmented spaces where folklore and surveillance intertwine. As environments distort, the line between memory and reality begins to dissolve.
supported_languages:
English*, Traditional Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
